command: PYTHONPATH=. uv run pytest -q plugins/fleet-core/tests/test_lease_broker.py -k "tolerant_mapping or extras_serialized_size or archived_fence_bound_is_a_strict_multiple"
covers: Tolerance primitives: _tolerant_mapping splits known from extras disjointly, keeps the strict missing-field error verbatim, rejects a non-object; _extras_serialized_size is 0 for empty and measures the canonical (ensure_ascii) form so key order and non-ASCII cannot change the count; the archived-fence bound is a strict multiple of the document bound.
